mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 8.0% indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate hiring and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 8.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates expanding economic activity and corporate hiring that supports earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction activity (HOUST) exceeding 700 thousand units signals robust housing market demand that stimulates related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 700, or Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding supply capacity and economic momentum that supports corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a CPIAUCSL index above 230 signals elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230 during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 2-year window.
